name: alignment_targets
description: Discover alignment targets from explicit seeds and transitive current authoring/source-scan references. Retains seeds first and dependent feature scene order, suppresses duplicates, excludes raw mesh/point-cloud dependents, and reports locked or unsupported targets and the 32-object limit. Read-only: review entityIds before passing them to alignment_preview/apply. Uses the same operation as Include dependent features in the alignment panel. Native complete controller and all authoring relationship types remain unfinished. Includes sibling outputs of selected active authoring features before dependent discovery; groupIds identifies those siblings. Retained authoring identities and links remain discoverable after baking.

name: backup_list
description: List browser-local project backups, their stable identities, save times, sizes and optional thumbnail artifacts. Backups update every 30 seconds only when changed.

name: backup_restore
description: Restore a browser backup with complete model history, continuing its existing backup identity. Requires explicit project replacement. Frames restored visible geometry and awaits presentation before completion. Legacy neutral/white point clouds without an explicit color mode migrate to solid green; explicit saved modes and RGB bytes are retained. Reference construction objects in the current scene, Undo or Redo history are not yet supported; rejection preserves the open workspace.

name: backup_delete
description: Delete a project backup and its legacy previous snapshot. The open model is unchanged; deleting its backup pauses automatic backups for the page session.

name: capabilities_get
description: Discover API version, complete command schemas, resource limits and supported features.

name: project_get
description: Inspect workspace, objects, feature recipes, authoring, history and settings; response revision guards writes.

name: object_get
description: Inspect an object. Optional geometry is returned as a bounded artifact, not in tool text. Counts follow the object's semantic kind; geometry artifacts do not substitute empty triangle buffers for semantic geometry. Saved constructionOrderKey identities are read-only. Indexed scanner normals and separate computed geometryNormals, when available, are included in original vertex order. Computed facetNormals are separate XYZ vectors in triangle order. Geometry JSON is measured before coordinate expansion and must fit the existing 1 GiB artifact capacity; use object_geometry_digest or project_export for larger geometry. Raw meshes expose meshPreparation with scheduled, pending/progress, ready/counts, error or inactive state for automatic selected-mesh preparation. Color summaries expose pointColorAttributes (rgba8, points, bytes) and ascAttributes; includeGeometry includes explicit pointColors byte arrays in its artifact.

name: object_geometry_digest
description: Read-only cancellable job: inspect stored display, indexed scan and point-cloud numeric carriers with bounded 1 MiB canonical staging instead of exporting large JSON arrays. Returns entityId, units:mm, per-buffer path/encoding/elements/rawBytes/SHA-256/storage/local backing alias IDs and optional point-cloud pose bits. Includes indexedMesh.geometryNormals separately from indexedMesh.normals and computed indexedMesh.facetNormals in triangle order when present. Float32 uses little-endian f32, ordinary number arrays f64, triangle indices u32. Yields between chunks; cancellation or changed project revision discards the result. No geometry/history mutation. Compare path, encoding, counts and hashes; backing IDs are local to one response, not persistent IDs. Poll job_get; cancel through job_cancel. Point-cloud colors are opaque RGBA byte carriers, reported as pointColors with canonical u8 encoding.

name: object_update
description: Change name/display/protection properties. Point clouds support pointSize (screen pixels, 1 to 10, default 1), pointColorMode (source: file RGB with object color fallback, default; solid: object color), pointAutoDensity (default true) and pointDensity (10 to 100 percent, default 100). Auto density uses stable camera-adaptive vertex sampling without moving retained points; false displays all eligible points. Source XYZ, RGB, hidden indexing, picking and export are preserved. Display options persist in project files and survive modeling undo. Read effective options with object_get and sampling diagnostics with viewport_get.pointCloudDisplay.

pointSize.description: Point-cloud diameter in screen pixels; default 1.

pointAutoDensity.description: Use stable camera-adaptive sampling; default true. False displays all eligible points.

pointDensity.description: Adaptive display density percentage, default 100. Larger values retain more source points. Existing saved values are preserved.

pointColorMode.description: source uses file RGB when present, otherwise object color; solid uses object color.

Returns deleted entityIds and legacy entityId for a single target.

Preserves geometry, selection, opacity, authored per-point RGB and modeling history. Empty/oversized scenes fail without changes. Returns changed, normalsDisplay:false and objects [{entityId,color}].

name: mesh_analyze
description: Explicitly compute full-resolution mesh topology diagnostics in a cancellable worker. Unchanged geometry reuses memory or a persistent content-, tolerance- and algorithm-version-keyed full topology cache across reopening. Result diagnostics.topologyCache reports persistent-hit, memory-hit, stored, unavailable or oversize, with topologyCacheBytes on persistent hits/writes. Selected raw scans up to 262144 facets prepare after render/idle in the background, sharing the GUI 0.001 tolerance index with queued mesh tools. Larger scans prepare on explicit diagnostics or topology-dependent tool requests; invalid or unavailable cached data falls back to analysis.

tolerance.description: Topology weld tolerance in mm; defaults to the GUI value of 0.001. Pass 0.000001 explicitly to reproduce the previous API default.

name: mesh_process
description: Execute scan tools, repair, smooth, reduce, segment, registration, scan editing, selection morphology or section extraction. Source geometry is owned by the workspace. Flip Normals retains valid indexed vertex identities, reverses indexed triangle winding and refreshes computed normals; indexed sources above 27 million vertex coordinates reject before worker dispatch. Segmentation objects retain their classifications and fits; responses expose segmentClassifications in segment order. Point clouds support pointCloudEdit deletion, extraction, point-count or voxel simplification, smoothing and radius-connected selection. Fine ICP matches the full target with bounded configurable source sampleSize (3-100000). overlapPercent defaults to 85 and replaces legacy trimFraction when supplied; do not supply both. targetRms defaults to 0.5 mm and checks overlapRms with overlapSatisfied, never whole-cloud RMS. Final wholeCloudRms (also legacy rms), maxError and pairs evaluate all eligible source points without trimming or distance rejection. overlapRms/overlapPoints (also inlierRms/inlierPairs) measure the closest requested percentage of eligible source points, gated by maxDistance. Insufficient matching points set overlapSatisfied:false and prevent targetReached. requiredOverlapPoints, fittingSamples, sampleSize, overlapPercent and targetRmsBasis:overlap make the accuracy basis explicit; overlapFraction/rejectedPoints expose distance-gated coverage. terminationReason is targetReached, stoppedImproving or iterationLimit; targetReached is the accuracy test, while converged includes a plateau. ICP targetSampleSize is accepted for compatibility but does not decimate the target. Whole-cloud paired, ICP and global registration preserve point type and native accumulated pose over immutable local buffers, with bounded CPU transforms; omit selectionOnly for point-cloud registration. Result diagnostics expose pointCloudPose and execution details. Bridge previews reuse prepared source topology without adopting preview geometry; committed bridges retain their successor topology. Hole refinement supports long fixed bridge rails with graded interior density. Inventory reports include holeOrder: closed-boundary indices sorted by descending boundary length, matching the GUI hole list without renumbering geometry references. Re-polygonize defaults to native signed-field extraction and half-count optimization, consuming visible raw meshes in scene order when targetIds is omitted. It creates a new owner and hides unchanged inputs; createNew:false explicitly replaces the requested owner. Native topology may remain open/nonmanifold and is reported. method=voxel retains the previous closed-shell behavior and replacement default. Internal indexed carriers resolve from workspace objects only. Unroll orients an exact CAD cylinder axis so its largest-magnitude component is positive (ties X, Y, Z); explicit numeric and construction directions retain their supplied sign. It selects the least-aligned world axis as the radial seed (ties X, Y, Z), shared by the mesh and Roll frame. Unroll publishes its output mesh, visible saved Sketch and hidden tangent Roll frame with retained radius in one transaction; terminal unroll reports all three identities and frame/mapping values. Model undo/redo/seek restores only the owned sketch identities. Split targetId binds persisted reference-plane frames as infinite planes; ordinary mesh cutters remain finite, including planar meshes with fits. Explicit operation plane parameters take precedence. Finite mesh Split updates the source as one indexed mesh and reports connected components; unchanged cuts return changed:false. Uncertain floating-point face coverage is checked against exact binary-coordinate area vectors before rejection; winding, edge and constraint checks still apply. Sampled CAD and other non-mesh cutters retain the existing segment-producing path. Reference-plane Split, extraction and segmentation retain the source hidden, create independently visible opaque parts, and select the first result. Source visibility is restored by model Undo/Redo/Seek and project reopening; unrelated display choices are preserved. Empty segment output rejects atomically. For Flip Normals with an eligible indexed source, job_get can report Validating indexed topology at zero progress after validation starts; job_cancel requests cancellation and terminal status confirms the outcome.

sampleInterval.description: Requested sampling spacing in mm; never silently coarsened.

gapFill.description: Maximum attempted gap scale in mm. Zero disables deliberate bridging.

extraThickness.description: Additional outward offset in mm, tapering at local fixed seams.

maxDeviation.description: Captured-surface fitting tolerance in mm, separately measured from sample spacing.

scope.description: Selected excludes hidden triangles. Isolated requires an actual hidden subset and uses visible triangles.

method.description: Defaults to native for all-mesh inputs and voxel when the source or selected targets include a point cloud. Explicit native rejects point-cloud inputs. Native uses the signed field, ordered repair and enabled half-count optimization; its output may remain open or nonmanifold. Voxel retains the closed occupancy-shell workflow. Method selection, input binding and ownership are shared by GUI and MCP.

resolution.description: Sampling spacing in mm, default 0.5; not a maximum-deviation tolerance. Native accepts raw meshes with independent signed-field/finalization/optimization working budgets and reports open or nonmanifold topology without claiming watertightness. Voxel accepts raw meshes and XYZ point clouds, including mixed inputs; every XYZ point uses radius sqrt(0.75) times spacing and scanner normals are not used. Reconstruction admits up to 500 million input coordinates and 256 MiB of private numeric transport payload including native indexed descriptors; immutable Float32 shared buffers are borrowed by a disposable worker. Payload admission is not a process memory bound. Voxel retains one billion grid points, 500 million sampling candidates and sixteen million output triangles. Oversized work fails without changing geometry or silently coarsening resolution.

tolerance.description: Search radius in mm, narrowed to positive finite Float32 (default 10). Boundary-region hits on open edges and hits exactly at the radius are excluded. Contributions accumulate in Float32 in object-list order.

offsetDegrees.description: Positive rotation of the cylinder radial frame in degrees. Seam-crossing facets are removed, using native swap-last deletion order.

instances.description: Copies translated along the arc-length axis. Aggregate output must fit the 3 million facet limit. Creates a separate owner by default; createNew:false explicitly replaces the source.

offsetDegrees.description: Positive rotation of the cylinder radial frame in degrees. Seam-crossing facets are removed, using native swap-last deletion order.

instances.description: Copies translated along the arc-length axis. Aggregate output must fit the 3 million facet limit. Creates a separate owner by default; createNew:false explicitly replaces the source.

cylinderId.description: Existing cylinder reference object. Exact CAD uses its analytic cylinder parameters; one cylinder face with optional planar caps is required. Multiple cylinders and mixed curved bodies reject without changing geometry. Construction cylinders retain their existing binding.

refineSurface.description: Refine a raw indexed moving scan after native coarse registration using targetId. The fixed target may be an indexed scan or exact CAD with cached kernel face triangulations. CAD conversion evaluates analytic D1 positions and normals at cached UV nodes and preserves the BRep. Target records are copied without welding and normals regenerated before refinement. Original landmark vertex seeds grow to 3000 faces or stability. Radius 3 mm. Coarse and delta retain separate Float32 stages.

overlapPercent.description: Expected portion of eligible source points to match (percent). Must have this many points within maxDistance before target accuracy can be reached. Use this or legacy trimFraction, not both.

targetRms.description: Desired overlap RMS in mm against the full target cloud. Defaults to 0.5. Distinct from the numerical stopping tolerance.

sampleSize.description: Maximum source fitting points; final overlap and whole-cloud RMS evaluate every eligible source point.

options.description: Scan section options shared with Create Sketch. selectedOnly uses current original triangle slots; omit top-level selectionOnly or supply the same value.

inventoryScope.description: Inventory only: return component faces and areas without calculating holes or boundaries. The inventory scope identifies this partial result; omit for the full inventory.

createSketches.description: Boundary projection only. Omit or false for the existing read-only XYZ curve artifact. true publishes validated saved planar sketches in one model-history transaction, retains the source and active authoring session, and returns sketchIds plus the curve artifact. Undo/Redo/Seek and project reopening retain the operation-owned sketch identities. Locked source publication is rejected before processing.

algorithm.description: Entire-hole Automatic selects Tangent for at most 40 rim edges and Curvature above 40. Entire-hole Curvature fits a local surface and remeshes the adjacent collar, including the original rim; it is not an append-only cap. surfaceRecovery explicitly continues the retained collar with bounded fallback; it requires mode entire. Partial/bridge Automatic retains its boundary-based choice.

endBoundary.description: Bridge destination boundary index from inventory, including closed loops and open chains. The indices array identifies exactly one start boundary. Omit to bridge within that same boundary; start/end identify local edge indices. Open paths have pointCount-1 edges.

diameter.description: Maximum enclosing-sphere diameter in mm for hole filling; 0 or omission includes all selected boundaries.

batch.description: Native multiple-hole Tangent dispatch, entire holes only. Omit algorithm or specify tangent; selected-hole Flat/Automatic/Curvature and surfaceRecovery require batch omitted or false. Optional indices restrict the batch.

anchors.description: Boundary smoothing only: zero-based boundary and point indices from the current scanEdit inventory. Two anchors must be on the same closed boundary, with at least two points between them on each side. Obtain a fresh inventory after geometry changes.

strength.description: Selected-area smoothing defaults to 0.5 and requires (0,1]. Boundary smoothing defaults to 1; [0,1] maps to native slider positions 0–10, rounded to the nearest step. Zero selects minimum native strength, not a disabled operation.

iterations.description: Selected-area smoothing defaults to 6 vertex passes. Boundary smoothing defaults to 1 complete command repetition, each with 10–20 vertex passes plus fitted-curve projection and boundary-preserving correction. Explicit values override these defaults.

tolerance.description: Topology weld tolerance in mm; defaults to the GUI value of 0.001. Pass 0.000001 explicitly to reproduce the previous API default.

fitTolerance.description: Positive boundary projection simplification tolerance or spatial-sketch fitting tolerance in mm. Spatial fitting defaults to 0.05 and is limited to 1024 closed boundaries and 200000 boundary points.

neighborRadius.description: Point neighborhood radius in mm; default 0.5.

deviation.description: Maximum cumulative displacement from original sample, mm; default 0.05.

seedVertices.description: Optional original indexed source vertex IDs. Grow a native one-ring region until at least 3000 faces or unchanged count; refine all selected visible region vertices without sampling. Existing selected face flags participate in the stopping count. Whole scan moves.

workerCount.description: Logical native lanes. Preserve this value when comparing serial and parallel output.

parallel.description: Use a bounded two-worker CPU pool when admitted; false evaluates the same logical lanes serially.

targetIds.description: For nativeRefine: nonempty ordered fixed indexed mesh targets, ties retain the first. For native scanTools/repolygonize: omission discovers eligible visible raw meshes in workspace order; [] means the source alone; explicit IDs compute in workspace order. Native input geometry remains unchanged and is hidden when creating a new owner; locked inputs cannot be hidden. Voxel reconstruction retains explicit ordered mesh/cloud IDs; omit for source alone and do not supply []. Other operations retain their existing nonempty-list requirements. Whole-scope shrinkwrap accepts raw meshes only. Up to 32 distinct IDs, excluding the source; mutually exclusive with targetId.

createNew.description: Native Re-polygonize defaults to a selected new mesh owner and hides unchanged input objects; false replaces the requested source owner instead. Voxel and other operations retain their existing ownership defaults. Revision, lock and history checks apply to both GUI and MCP.

previewOnly.description: For scanEdit fillHoles mode bridge only: return the generated facet strip as a JSON artifact and continuity diagnostics without changing geometry or history. Requires one start boundary in indices and explicit start/end edge indices; endBoundary optionally selects a different closed loop or open chain. Omit selectionOnly, createNew and targets.

name: analysis_deviation

Optional signed:true uses local reference winding; default reference distances are unsigned. Returns statistics, coverage, retained parameters, legacy distance artifact and reproducible JSON report. Hidden/unmatched samples are null in source order. CAD reference uses Float32 display tessellation, not exact BREP distance; neither mode certifies continuous bounds or solid containment. Limit 2250000 coordinates per object.

Symmetric acceptance/color threshold in mm; default 0.1.

Edge/face indices are valid only at expectedRevision. Analytic sketch-curves and legacy sketch extrusion recipes join exactly equal local UV endpoints in the derived wire even when point IDs differ; authored IDs, constraints and recipe graphs remain unchanged. Real gaps are not snapped, and zero-length edges, branches and disconnected cycles are rejected.

name: sketch_get
description: Inspect the active planar draft and saved sketches. Spatial boundary sketches use kind:spatial and retain cubic poles, knots, periodic flags and fitting diagnostics in world millimetres; spatial editing is not yet available.

name: sketch_set
description: Replace the active sketch draft with a validated Sketch v1; With solve:true, solve and apply atomically; conflicting constraints leave the draft unchanged. Returns solution diagnostics when solving. Supports collinear constraints {id,kind:'collinear',first,second} on two distinct finite straight segments of length at least 1e-10 mm: both supporting lines coincide, including disjoint or reversed segments, without welding endpoints or equating lengths. Collinear residuals are signed endpoint-to-line distances in local UV millimetres. CAD remains unchanged until rebuild/extrude.

solve.description: Solve before applying; reject conflicting or unsolved constraints without modifying the active draft.

name: sketch_corner_trim
description: Join two straight sketch lines at their analytic infinite-line intersection by trimming or extending selected endpoints. Uses the active draft, preserves placement and unrelated geometry, and records one sketch edit. Rejects parallel/degenerate lines, collapsed results, affected constraints and endpoints used by other primitives without changes. Already joined endpoints return changed:false. Returns changed, intersection in sketch UV millimetres and shared pointId. General paint trimming, arcs and fillets are separate operations.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

name: sketch_corner_fillet
description: Round explicitly selected ends of two straight sketch lines with an analytic tangent arc of radiusMm in sketch-local millimetres. Uses the active draft and publishes one sketch edit; preserves placement, references, opposite ends, line IDs, unrelated geometry and constraints. Returns changed:true, intersection, ordered tangentPoints, center, radiusMm and arcId; read sketch_get for the exact arc/topology. Splits a shared selected corner ID when needed. Rejects invalid or excessive radius, parallel/degenerate lines, collapsed retained rays, mismatched construction policies, affected constraints, endpoints shared with unrelated primitives and resource exhaustion atomically. Does not infer automatic radius or transfer constraints. Limits:32768 input/output points,8192 input/output curves,4096 constraints,2000000 counted work units including validation.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

name: sketch_trim_stroke
description: Paint away analytic line/arc/circle intervals between actual sketch intersections using an unsnapped UV millimetre stroke and radiusMm. Uses the active draft and one shared sketch edit; no-hit returns changed:false. Preserves unrelated geometry, placement and constraints; rejects affected constraints, ambiguous overlaps and exceeded work limits atomically. Retained nonperiodic arc pieces become straight segments when their absolute normalized midpoint-chord dot exceeds 0.9999996192282494; equality stays curved. This includes small and nearly full sweeps. IDs/construction flags survive conversion; inspect both segments and arcs in sketch_get. Circles stored as two arcs are periodic, so their storage seam is not a trim stop and this fallback does not apply. Returns changed, removedCurveIds, retainedCurveIds and intersectionCount. Limits:4096 stroke points,32768 sketch points,4096 constraints,512 stored curves,65536 intersections,8192 output curves,2000000 work units.

stroke.description: Unsnapped ordered sketch UV coordinates in millimetres; one point paints a disk.

name: sketch_mirror
description: Copy selected analytic sketch lines/arcs/circles across an existing straight construction axis in local UV millimetres. Uses the active draft and one shared sketch edit. Originals, constraints, shared endpoint topology, construction flags, frame and scan references are preserved; copies have no new constraints and arc direction reverses. Select both stored arcs to copy a two-arc circle. curveIds must be unique, nonempty and exclude axis. Returns changed:true, pointMap, curveMap, createdPointIds and createdCurveIds; maps use source IDs and output IDs are deterministic in stored geometry order. Read sketch_get for copied geometry; history_undo/history_redo scope:sketch steps this edit. Rejects invalid or degenerate axes, unknown curves, coordinates outside +/-1e9 mm, cancellation, changed revisions and exceeded limits atomically. Limits:32768 input/output points,8192 input/output stored curves,4096 constraints,4096 selected curves,2000000 work units.

axis.description: Existing straight construction segment ID; the infinite supporting line is the mirror axis.

curveIds.description: Existing line/arc IDs to copy, excluding the axis. Include both semicircles for a stored two-arc circle.

Options method defaults to projected-grid; approximate uses recovered XYZ approximation arithmetic with a nonnegative regularizationWeight (default 0.0001). Approximation admits at most 10000 actual samples and bounded workspace/work before allocation. Both methods use explicit projected UV, not full native iterative orientation/tolerance fitting. Closed automatic reconstruction remains unsupported.

options.description: SurfaceFitOptions; validated by existing surface fitter

regularizationWeight.description: Approximate method only; default 0.0001. Native core penalty weights are 0, 1 and 0.1.

selectionOnly.description: Fit selected visible triangles of the active raw mesh, or selected XYZ points of the active point cloud. Hidden mesh facets are excluded. Default false fits the whole input.

name: project_import
description: Import a completed artifact: project, STL/OBJ/polygon PLY, ASC point cloud or STEP/IGES/BREP. Fresh ASC clouds start in solid lime green while retaining file RGB for source mode. Fresh workspaces preserve scan coordinates; omitted placeAtOrigin uses settings.importPlaceAtOrigin; placeAtOrigin=true centers scan XY bounds and places its base on Z=0 after unit conversion. CAD/project placement is retained. replace=true required for project replacement. Project replacement frames restored visible geometry and awaits presentation. Legacy neutral/white clouds without an explicit color mode migrate to solid green. Geometry stays local. ASC attribute interpretation is shared with GUI; ascAttributes overrides settings.importAscAttributes for this request. Reference construction objects in the current scene, Undo or Redo history are not yet supported; rejection preserves the open workspace.

name: project_import_batch

CAD remains serialized with its placement retained. Large batches, constrained devices or low reported heap headroom fall back to one parser. job_get.progressDetails reports per-file index, name, status, fraction and stage. Each rendered file gets one undo step; preserves completed objects on failure or cancellation. Returns completed results and per-file failures. Artifact storage is bounded to 64 handles totaling 1 GiB. ASC attribute interpretation is shared with GUI; ascAttributes overrides settings.importAscAttributes for this request.

name: viewport_set
description: Set standard camera view; fit frames the visible workspace.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

name: settings_set
description: Set display, grid and scan-import preferences through the application.

importPlaceAtOrigin.description: Default for GUI and MCP scan imports when no per-import placeAtOrigin override is supplied. Initially false preserves source coordinates. True centers XY bounds and places the base on Z=0. Does not move existing objects or create model history.

automaticGrid.description: Adapt floor spacing to model size (default true). Disable to use gridSpacing for the display. Sketch snapping always uses gridSpacing.

importAscAttributes.description: Default ASC interpretation for future GUI/MCP imports. Initially xyz-rgb. Does not reinterpret existing scans or create model history.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

name: job_get
description: Inspect running/completed job; poll at modest intervals. Hole-filling jobs expose progressDetails with kind holeFill, phase closing/finalizing/complete, processed, total, closed and skipped counts. Total counts unique selected boundaries, including those skipped by the diameter limit or patch validation.

name: job_cancel
description: Request cancellation. Native CAD may settle before releasing its admission lane; no cancelled output is committed.

name: artifact_put
description: Create/append a local upload artifact with ordered base64 chunks (maximum 1 MiB decoded). Storage is bounded to 64 handles totaling 1 GiB, with a 15-minute inactivity lease. Large browser uploads checkpoint to temporary disk backing every 64 MiB; storage failure preserves the previous size. Append at the exact current byte offset; expired handles cannot be resumed. This grants no workspace edit.

name: artifact_read
description: Read an artifact as base64 chunks; expires15min after last use.

name: artifact_delete
description: Release a transient artifact (does not delete a project file).

name: project_new
description: Create an empty workspace. Explicit discard=true required; export unsaved work first.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

name: object_select
description: Select objects in tree order: ordinary selection replaces, toggle adds/removes, range selects from the last ordinary/toggle anchor. Combine toggle and range to add a range. Omit entityId to clear. Returns active and all selected IDs.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

range.description: Shift-click range semantics in object tree order; skips locked/unselectable objects

name: object_visibility_toggle
description: Toggle each target object visibility atomically, preserving geometry, selection and existing display-history semantics. Omit entityIds to use current object selection. Visibility may change on locked objects.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

entityIds.description: Objects to toggle once each; omit to use current selected objects.

name: object_rename
description: Rename explicit entityIds or the current object selection atomically. Names follow existing display-metadata behavior and are preserved across geometry undo. One object uses name verbatim after trimming; multiple objects receive name - 1, name - 2, etc. in Objects-panel order. Selection and geometry are preserved. Empty, missing or duplicate IDs and names exceeding 200 characters after numbering fail without changes.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

entityIds.description: Objects to rename; omit to use current selected objects. Numbering follows Objects-panel order.

name: history_seek
description: Seek to a retained modeling timeline index (0 is starting state).

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

name: scan_selection_get
description: Inspect selected scan edit state: active editor, shape tool, through, clip (world mm), counts, selection history availability, sensitivity degrees and brush radius in CSS pixels. No geometry mutation.

name: scan_selection_control
description: Configure the shared Edit scan tool, see-through state or clipping box (world mm, null disables); hide/isolate/reveal elements or undo/redo selection history independently of geometry history. Requires an unlocked visible selected scan. Clipping is active while Edit scan is open. Does not commit model geometry. Read scan_selection_get after changes. revealSelected matches Show last hidden: reveal and reselect only the last hidden source slots, retaining earlier hidden batches.

name: scan_select_region
description: Cancellable shared GUI screen selection against the current selected scan/camera. Open Edit scan first. Coordinates are CSS pixels from viewport top-left, dimensions available from viewport_get. rectangle/circle use start/end; lasso is filled freehand; brush is an open stroke (two points form a straight stroke), radius in CSS pixels. Respects hidden slots, self-occlusion unless through:true, and active clipping. operation replaces (default), adds or subtracts. Original triangle/point IDs remain unchanged. One selection-history step, no model-history step. Poll job_get, cancel job_cancel; read selection_get artifact for exact source slots.

name: selection_modify
description: Select all, clear or invert visible mesh triangle slots or point-cloud sample slots without transferring large arrays. Hidden source slots remain unselected.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

name: selection_saved
description: Save, load or delete a persistent named mesh/point-cloud selection using original source slots. Loading excludes currently hidden slots.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

name: sketch_manage
description: Create/activate/rename/delete a saved sketch, or set its independent saved visibility with action:visibility and visible:boolean. Spatial sketches may be renamed, deleted or shown/hidden but cannot be activated in the planar editor. Uses the same authoring state and display as the editor. Unset visibility is hidden; Unroll creates its auxiliary sketch visible without replacing the active edit session.

visible.description: Required for action:visibility; independent of active sketch editing.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

name: mesh_quick
description: Clean degenerate facets or center/align principal axes using editor geometry helpers.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

name: surface_operation
description: Use editor NURBS helpers: grid, ordered quad import, knot insertion, crease preparation, scan control snapping or compatible C0/C1 joining.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only identical request, retained for latest256 requests

name: surface_shell
description: Inspect compatible patch seam/topology diagnostics or generate a box patch shell. Returns an artifact suitable for closedShell CAD recipe.

name: screenshot_capture
description: Capture current application or viewport as a native MCP image and downloadable artifact. Includes current WebGL pixels; password/token inputs redacted. Local DOM rendering excludes OS/browser chrome. Bounded 2048px,1MiB,10s; reduce dimensions or use JPEG on limit.

name: application_inspect
description: Reports contextMenuPolicy application-only: native browser right-click menus are suppressed throughout the document while application context handlers and existing semantic MCP actions remain available. Inspect current visible dialogs, bounded accessible controls, statuses/errors, GUI preview/progress, active panel and workspace. Credential/file-input values omitted. Use semantic tools instead of clicking.

name: command_get
description: Inspect repeatable ribbon and keyboard command identities, availability and the last command.

name: command_run
description: Launch a discovered repeatable command with the current selection and remember it for Spacebar. Returns launch acknowledgement, not operation completion. Active dialogs and busy operations reject launches. ribbon:alignNPoints resolves an active eligible scan, a uniquely selected scan, or the sole eligible scan; a fixed target is optional. command_get reports the same eligibility as its GUI entry.

name: command_repeat
description: Repeat the last repeatable GUI or command_run command using current selection and settings. Returns launch acknowledgement, not operation completion. Rejects unavailable commands, busy operations and active dialogs.

name: ui_set
description: Set ribbon tab, tool workspace, interaction mode and panel/settings visibility or dismiss displayed error. Semantic reference selections reject sampled-geometry panels and brush/section modes before changing interface state; select a mesh/cloud or CAD object for those controls. Changing workspace rejects active GUI previews; does not accept/cancel them. datumAlignmentOpen opens/closes reference-based coordinate alignment. Opening requires a selected unlocked scan or exact CAD object and opens properties with inspect mode; closing an active alignment preview is rejected until discarded. globalAlignmentOpen opens Global Fine Align for 2 to 32 eligible visible scan meshes; close it after Apply or Cancel.

name: spacemouse_get
description: Read SpaceMouse connection source (gamepad, driver, webhid or null), status, browser capability and session preferences. Driver navigation sensitivity is managed by 3DxWare. No hardware permission prompt.

name: spacemouse_control
description: Use automatic Gamepad detection, explicitly connect the official local 3Dconnexion driver, disable navigation, or change session Gamepad/HID preferences. One input source owns navigation. Driver loss resumes automatic detection. Requires installed 3DxWare for connectDriver; never opens a WebHID permission chooser. Does not edit model history.

name: viewport_get
description: Optional view selects main (default), moving or fixed; picking views require an active landmark session and use independent original-pose cameras. Read camera projection/position/target/up/zoom and copied projectionMatrix/cameraWorldMatrix (cameraMatrixFormat:column-major-4x4), session navigation.orbitMode and navigation.zoomWindowActive, visible scene bounds and CSS viewport dimensions. Main view pointCloudDisplay reports visible clouds [{entityId,autoDensity,density,eligiblePoints,sampleFraction,estimatedDisplayedPoints,samplingMethod,cellSizePx,maxScreenOffsetPx}]. samplingMethod is stable-sample or full. Compatibility fields cellSizePx and maxScreenOffsetPx are always null and zero; retained points are not moved. Counts/fractions estimate sampled points before clipping/occlusion, not exact selected vertices or modified source data. Includes Interactive mirror readiness/failure diagnostics when its display provider is installed. No model geometry transfer. orbitCenter exposes the active mouse/SpaceMouse world-mm pivot and marker visibility. While the hole tool is open, bridge.mode distinguishes holes from bridge; hovered boundary references also report direct hole picking.

name: viewport_control
description: Point-cloud pointer hits bridge gaps between rendered scan dots using the nearest depth sample within 6 CSS pixels, keeping the pivot on the pointer ray. Only when that local hit test misses is the screen-center/model-depth fallback used. Normalized x/y rotation resolves a fresh pointer surface, then frame-center surface, then screen center at visible model bounds depth; empty-space misses never use a stale pivot or an unrelated camera look-at depth. Large point clouds use rendered depth with displayed point sizes, transforms and clipping. Optional view selects main (default), moving or fixed; picking views require an active landmark session and use independent original-pose cameras. Frame all/object/active selection; zoom to a normalized rectangle; set session free/constrained orbit or arm/cancel window zoom; set projection; rotate by degrees (optionally around the surface at normalized x/y); orient to active sketch; or set an absolute world-mm camera pose. Uses editor camera controls and leaves model/history unchanged.

orbitMode.description: Session orbit mode. Constrained keeps world Z upright; free preserves unrestricted trackball orbit.

zoomWindowActive.description: Arm or cancel the next left-drag window zoom without changing model selection.

x0.description: Normalized top-left viewport coordinate; reversed corners are accepted. Both dimensions must span at least 4 CSS pixels.

y0.description: Normalized top-left viewport coordinate; reversed corners are accepted. Both dimensions must span at least 4 CSS pixels.

x1.description: Normalized top-left viewport coordinate; reversed corners are accepted. Both dimensions must span at least 4 CSS pixels.

y1.description: Normalized top-left viewport coordinate; reversed corners are accepted. Both dimensions must span at least 4 CSS pixels.

x.description: Surface orbit horizontal coordinate in normalized top-left space; requires y.

y.description: Surface orbit vertical coordinate in normalized top-left space; requires x.

name: viewport_pick
description: Optional view selects main (default), moving or fixed; picking views require an active landmark session and use independent original-pose cameras. Inspect visible rendered geometry at normalized top-left viewport x/y. Return ordered object IDs, world-mm points, distances, tessellation triangle indices or pointIndex. Semantic reference hits report referenceKind, triangleIndex:null and no cloud pointIndex; reference project admission remains gated. Respects visibility, protection and clipping. Read-only; native CAD edge/face IDs are separate.

name: history_get
description: Read retained modeling history labels and current cursor, including redo entries. Indices match history_seek; inspect fresh project revision before seeking.

name: project_update
description: Rename current project without replacing objects, authoring, history or backup identity.

name: session_get
description: Recover active/retained job IDs, progress/errors and transient artifact metadata/expiry without transferring results or file contents. GUI operations may be busy without an API job.

name: tools_search
description: Find compact tools by query terms in names, descriptions, supported parameters and nested subcommands (e.g. fillet, reducePolygons). Return optional exact schemas. Prefer this over repeating the full catalog. Empty query lists a bounded subset.

name: preview_discard
description: Explicitly discard one GUI scan/surface/landmark/sketch-section preview using the same Cancel handlers as the editor. Available while GUI workers are busy. Preserve committed model; never accepts a preview. Cancel API jobs separately with job_cancel. Global alignment discard also cancels its active preparation and clears its cached preview.

name: alignment_references
description: Read exact CAD face, fitted primitive or stored semantic point/line alignment references without changing geometry or history. Semantic sources return referenceConstruction and object-local /reference/point or /reference/direction IDs; line direction references retain the stored extent and native midpoint convention. Semantic creation/import remains gated pending construction integration; discovery does not permit moving these sources. Returns paged points, directions and display triangle ranges in mm; exact CAD cylinder faces also expose their kernel radiusMm. Unsupported surfaces are explicit. This read-only native job uses job_get/job_cancel; use fresh results after any model edit. Optional triangleIndex resolves the exact face picked in the canvas.

centerAt.description: Optional world-space point projected onto planar references

triangleIndex.description: Optional original render triangle slot. Resolves exactly one CAD face using its half-open tessellation range; fitted-only and semantic reference objects cannot resolve a triangle.

name: alignment_preview
description: Preview object coordinate alignment from one to three native plane/direction/point constraints. Targets are unlocked meshes, point clouds or exact CAD bodies. Ordered constraints build the reference frame; its rigid inverse transforms scans. Exact CAD uses verified OpenCascade axis-frame placement and retains exact topology. Model/history stay unchanged; preview_discard target datum restores the committed scene and releases temporary CAD handles. Optional translation is in reference-frame axes (mm), not world axes. Constraints may bind reference IDs returned by alignment_references; exact CAD, fitted and semantic point/line inputs are read again from the current revision. Large scans use bounded CPU workers when admitted; each target reports execution diagnostics and serial fallback reason. Source-scan references are retained and reported even when stale fitting patches are cleared. Nonidentity CAD placement retains authoringLinks identity and resolved references when clearing its stale recipe. Include dependent recipes and every output of each affected authoring feature; incomplete groups fail before CAD allocation. Identity placement retains the original recipe. Point-cloud alignment retains immutable local buffers and composes the verified double pose; pointCloudPose in each target is its exact little-endian Float64 hex frame. World geometry remains available through object_get. Rendering retains GPU buffers; derived world bounds/views may use bounded CPU workers. Binary project format 3 deduplicates local cloud buffers through history; older format 2 remains readable.

translation.description: Optional X/Y/Z offsets in mm along the constructed reference frame basis, applied before rigid inversion. Defaults to no offset.

translationPoint.description: Optional picked world point in mm. Resolve it in the current source-reference frame and replace translation with those offsets; the picked point becomes the aligned origin.

parallel.description: Enable bounded CPU worker execution for large scans (default true); false uses cancellable serial chunks with identical native arithmetic.

name: alignment_apply
description: Apply native coordinate-frame object alignment to unlocked meshes, point clouds or exact CAD bodies as one history transaction. Scan indexed topology and saved selections are preserved; exact CAD uses verified OpenCascade axis-frame placement, retains BRep topology and preserves fitted primitive parameters with verified native transforms and clears stale authoring/display-selection metadata. Same constraints as alignment_preview; source geometry is checked before commit. Cancellation releases temporary CAD outputs; committed source/result handles remain valid for Undo/Redo. Optional translation is in reference-frame axes (mm), not world axes. Constraints may bind reference IDs returned by alignment_references; exact CAD, fitted and semantic point/line inputs are read again from the current revision. Large scans use bounded CPU workers when admitted; each target reports execution diagnostics and serial fallback reason. Source-scan references are retained and reported even when stale fitting patches are cleared. Nonidentity CAD placement retains authoringLinks identity and resolved references when clearing its stale recipe. Include dependent recipes and every output of each affected authoring feature; incomplete groups fail before CAD allocation. Identity placement retains the original recipe. Point-cloud alignment retains immutable local buffers and composes the verified double pose; pointCloudPose in each target is its exact little-endian Float64 hex frame. World geometry remains available through object_get. Rendering retains GPU buffers; derived world bounds/views may use bounded CPU workers. Binary project format 3 deduplicates local cloud buffers through history; older format 2 remains readable.

translation.description: Optional X/Y/Z offsets in mm along the constructed reference frame basis, applied before rigid inversion. Defaults to no offset.

translationPoint.description: Optional picked world point in mm. Resolve it in the current source-reference frame and replace translation with those offsets; the picked point becomes the aligned origin.

parallel.description: Enable bounded CPU worker execution for large scans (default true); false uses cancellable serial chunks with identical native arithmetic.

name: landmark_preview
description: Solve the active picked-point session through the GUI preview worker without committing geometry or history. Returns a job; poll job_get. Raw indexed moving scans use native coarse registration, seeded region growth and refinement against indexed scans or exact CAD fixed targets. CAD conversion reuses kernel face triangulations, evaluates analytic D1 positions and normals at their UV nodes, and preserves the BRep. Publishes coarse registration, refinement, diagnostics and markers through landmark_get. Moving point clouds retain their point type, immutable local buffers, normals and composed native double pose; large world-view transforms use at most two CPU workers. Their paired solve sends only picked coordinates to its worker. Cancel through job_cancel or preview_discard targeting landmarks. Refinement uses the session targetScope; visibleScene orders visible evaluated CAD roots before visible indexed scans, excludes superseded CAD inputs using authoring dependency update order, excludes the moving scan, and preserves the fixed geometry. Hidden evaluated consumers still suppress their CAD inputs; exempt construction primitives alone do not. Cyclic authoring dependencies are rejected. With no eligible refinement surfaces, an indexed moving scan retains coarse alignment and native grown selection, reports an accepted identity refinement with the native maximum-float error sentinel, and uses one physical worker without creating a correspondence pool. A successful preview contains one native matrix. Repeat preview is permitted; editing cancels superseded calculations. Poll landmark_get.previewStatus for automatic previews scheduled by edits. Alignment target trees use a 512 MiB estimate for object nodes, live memberships and packed query transport, separate from geometry buffers; there is no public override. Budget exhaustion reports OPERATION_FAILED with required and allowed estimated bytes. The test-process memory cap is separate.

name: landmark_accept
description: Accept the current picked-point preview through the GUI commit operation. Requires an unchanged, unlocked source and target and a valid preview. Creates one model history step, preserves the fixed target and closes the session. Use a fresh revision and request ID after the preview job completes. Float32 indexed normals retain Float32 render storage and signed zero through the shared commit; legacy numeric-array normals retain their precision. object_geometry_digest reports the resulting buffer encoding.

name: landmark_get
description: Read active live session pairCount, previewStatus (idle/pending/ready/error), previewError, original picks, result markers and isolated moving/fixed view entityIds and original-pose markers. Edits auto-preview from three complete pairs; poll previewStatus until ready before acceptance. Read the active picked-point alignment session, original world-coordinate picks, transformed preview markers and editable preview state, with coarse registration, refinement and execution diagnostics when a preview exists. Point-cloud previews also expose pointCloudPose as a little-endian Float64 frame. Also reports optional fixedId (null for all references) and captured referenceIds. Does not mutate geometry or history. Reports canPreview, canReset, canRemove, candidateCount and candidateIndex for the ordinary native single-matrix preview state. In internal semantic workspaces, reference points and lines are exempt from dependency-priority suppression of their source; they are not refinement surfaces. Read ordered refinementTargetIds to verify scene target admission.

name: landmark_edit
description: GUI uses the top-right fixed canvas and bottom-right moving canvas without pick modes. action remove-point requires entityId and zero-based pointIndex within that entity in landmark_get.picks order. remove-last and clear accept optional entityId to affect only that canvas; omit for legacy whole-session removal. Point edits invalidate and recompute the preview with the usual complete-pair rules. action view-layout sets referenceWidthPercent (finite percentage clamped to 20-50, default 32) without canceling previews or changing picks/history. landmark_get.layout reports configured percent, bounds and responsive minimum widths (reference 220px, result 360px where space permits). Begin or edit the shared picked-point alignment session. Begin requires movingId; fixedId is optional and filters reference picking. With no fixedId, fixed points may come from any visible selectable unlocked reference in the captured scene. reference-target binds fixedId or clears it when omitted, resets picks and preview, and defaults cleared binding to visibleScene. pick requires entityId and a world-coordinate point in mm. Picked coordinates are rounded to native Float32 precision and stored as doubles; values outside the finite Float32 range are rejected. Any number of ordered pairs is supported. Picks, removal and clear remain available after preview and invalidate the previous result. Three or more equally sized moving/fixed point groups automatically schedule a new preview; incomplete groups cannot be accepted. Poll landmark_get previewStatus (idle, pending, ready, error) and previewError. New edits cancel superseded work. reset cancels preview and retains original picks without auto-restarting. These edits do not create model history. Use landmark_preview to solve, landmark_accept to commit, and preview_discard to close/cancel. Begin defaults to visibleScene refinement against visible evaluated exact CAD roots and other visible indexed scans; fixedId is an optional canvas picking filter. Use targetScope fixed for single-target refinement. action target-scope changes scope and resets preview while retaining picks. landmark_get reports targetScope, refinementTargetIds, pairCount, previewStatus, previewError and views with original-pose markers and isolated entityIds. The GUI has a result view and independent moving/reference picking views. viewport_get/control/pick accept view main, moving or fixed. GUI starts with the first eligible reference selected; unbound sessions retain multi-reference agent picking, while the reference view displays the first eligible reference. Scene geometry/order/visibility changes invalidate a scene-target preview. Point clouds are not mesh-facet refinement targets. Moving clouds use coarse registration and retained native poses. Complete original point-cloud dialog admission and workflow parity remain unverified.

pointIndex.description: Zero-based point index within entityId picks; required for remove-point. Refresh landmark_get after edits.

referenceWidthPercent.description: Picking-view column width as a percentage of the alignment viewport; clamped to 20-50. Required for action view-layout.

fixedId.description: Optional reference picking filter. Omit at begin for all captured visible references. With action reference-target, omission clears the filter and resets picks and preview.

targetScope.description: Begin defaults to visibleScene: visible exact CAD first, then other visible indexed scans in scene order. fixed preserves single-target refinement. target-scope changes this choice and resets preview while retaining picks.

name: interactive_alignment_get
description: Inspect the active Interactive scan-alignment session: version, Double poses, pivot, measured bounds, drag strength, mirror options, source readiness and worker diagnostics. No geometry transfer.

name: interactive_alignment_edit
description: Begin or edit Interactive alignment for one to 32 unlocked visible mesh/point-cloud scans. Preview uses display poses and leaves authored geometry/history unchanged. Later edits require the latest sessionId and expectedSessionVersion. Strength is percent; step angles are degrees and translations mm; axes are 0=X/1=Y/2=Z. Drag translation/rotation handles use normalized top-left viewport points, including captured points outside the viewport. Mirror is a mesh-only visual reference across XY/YZ/XZ. Apply separately or cancel with preview_discard target interactive.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only for an identical request.
Unique retry receipt; reuse only for an identical request.
Unique retry receipt; reuse only for an identical request.

value.description: Step magnitude rounded to finite Float32; positive/negative control determines sign.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only for an identical request.
Unique retry receipt; reuse only for an identical request.
Unique retry receipt; reuse only for an identical request.

handle.description: 1/2/3 translate in YZ/XZ/XY planes; 4/5/6 translate on X/Y/Z axes; 10/11/12 rotate about X/Y/Z.

name: interactive_alignment_apply
description: Apply the active Interactive session once using its latest session/version. Mesh geometry is baked once; point clouds retain their source/Double pose representation. Creates one model-history entry when changed and releases preview resources. Returns a job receipt; inspect job_get. Cancel with preview_discard target interactive.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only for an identical request.

name: scan_preview
description: Preview Reduce noise, Reduce polygons, Scale mesh, Mirror mesh or ShrinkWrap without modifying source or history, compare to the source with sampled surface statistics, accept into history (optionally createNew) or cancel. Create requires operation; later phases require returned previewId and entityId. One disposable preview per editor, expires after 60 seconds; changed source/references or expired worker comparison requires recreation. References and local masks resolve identically to GUI and mesh_process. Compare statistics are sampled, not a certified bound. Revision guards, retry receipts, cancellation and locks apply. Mirror uses a principal plane or referenceId with plane=object. Noise selectionOnly resolves the current source selection. Reduction GUI compares after create; agents can explicitly compare the same retained output before acceptance. Threshold changes never rerun the geometry operation.

sampleInterval.description: Requested sampling spacing in mm; never silently coarsened.

gapFill.description: Maximum attempted gap scale in mm. Zero disables deliberate bridging.

extraThickness.description: Additional outward offset in mm, tapering at local fixed seams.

maxDeviation.description: Captured-surface fitting tolerance in mm, separately measured from sample spacing.

scope.description: Selected excludes hidden triangles. Isolated requires an actual hidden subset and uses visible triangles.

paletteThreshold.description: Comparison color threshold in mm; defaults to deviation.

displayRange.description: Comparison display range in mm; defaults to deviation for polygon reduction.

name: global_alignment_preview
description: Preview Global Fine Align for 2 to 32 visible unlocked triangle scan meshes already approximately aligned. Uses the shared multicore controller. Defaults to all eligible visible scans in scene order; point clouds and exact CAD are excluded with reasons, partially hidden meshes are rejected. Search tolerance is absolute Float32 mm (default 0.5; zero allowed). Preparation and query memory admission apply. Job returns a cached 60-second preview and per-scan convergence, stability, distance and coverage diagnostics; non-convergence is explicit and does not commit. Use job_get/job_cancel and global_alignment_state; Apply reuses exactly the staged geometry. Outer diagnostics include copied controller poses and ordered application stages as row-major 3x4 matrices with exact Float64 little-endian hex bits (translation in mm).

name: global_alignment_apply
description: Apply an unexpired Global Fine Align preview exactly once as one history step, without recomputing. Requires unchanged source geometry, history, settings and authoring state. Non-converged results may be explicitly applied after inspecting diagnostics. Returns the same staged outer transform receipt, including exact matrix bits and controller-issued application sequence.

name: global_alignment_cancel
description: Cancel preparation or discard the staged Global Fine Align preview and close its panel. Available while its preview job is running; preserves originals and history. Optional jobId scopes automatic cleanup to its owning preparation/preview; a mismatched ID leaves newer work and its panel unchanged. Omit jobId to explicitly cancel the current global preview.

name: global_alignment_state
description: Read Global Fine Align state, preview lease, settings, source IDs, memory/input summary and per-scan convergence diagnostics, plus copied outer poses and controller-issued application stages (row-major 3x4 matrices, Float64 little-endian hex bits, translation in mm).

name: inspection_display
description: Show or clear the most recent retained deviation report on its original source geometry using the editor heatmap. Read analysis_deviation.inspectionId first. Requires revision/retry guards; adds no modeling history. Reports expire after 15 minutes, another analysis, source/reference edits or API disposal. Gray denotes hidden/unmatched samples. Recompute stale reports. Actions measurement and section display validated world picks or the selected visible triangle section using the same GUI controls; clear also removes these overlays.

name: inspection_get
description: Read the up-to-32 project-persistent measurement/deviation definitions. Definitions retain parameters, not stale heatmap buffers. Run explicitly to recompute against current referenced geometry.

name: inspection_manage
description: Save a named inspection definition or delete one, using revision/retry guards. Retains project authoring and survives save/reopen/backups; no modeling history entry. At most 32 definitions; invalid/degenerate definitions fail atomically.

tolerance.description: Symmetric acceptance/color threshold in mm; default 0.1.
Symmetric acceptance/color threshold in mm; default 0.1.

maxDistance.description: Exclusive search radius in world mm. Unmatched samples remain null and reduce coverage.

signed.description: Default false. True uses nearest reference triangle winding, not watertight inside/outside.

name: inspection_run
description: Recompute a saved definition against current geometry. Measurement results retain ordered world picks; deviation jobs return the same statistics/artifacts/inspectionId as analysis_deviation. Missing referenced objects fail. Poll/cancel the normal job; adds no history.
